basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old amateur mycologist living in the Pacific Northwest. By day, I work as a graphic designer, and by night, I'm either playing Dungeons and Dragons with friends or experimenting with my latest mushroom cultivation projects. I have a keen interest in alternative hip-hop, especially artists like Yelawolf. I tend to browse Reddit during late evenings after work, usually around 8 PM to midnight. Currently single, I enjoy spending my free time hiking and exploring the lush forests around my area.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design with a degree from a local art school. My interest in mycology started as a hobby, inspired by the rich natural environment around me. I've learned mostly through online forums, including Reddit communities and YouTube tutorials.
behavioral_pattern.relationship_with_community_policies: familiar but not time-sensitive. I generally follow subreddit rules but occasionally need reminders about specific guidelines.
